scope: Read-only production source review and CPU-only temporary-file flock counterexample; no production lock acquisition, GPU access, process signal, code/config/data edit, scheduling, freeze or qualification gate creation.
proposal: H-only lifetime GPU flock first, then after-lock old-D-batch drain witness from queue status/proc locks/process identities.

critical_findings.claim: The after-lock witness can certify an admitted branch, but acquiring the lock in order to evaluate that witness may abort an already-dispatched D child even when H subsequently refuses admission.
full_interleaving: D old batch drains and the last P2 status can remain stale while the owner begins a later batch.
D reserved() temporarily obtains then releases a free GPU lock and records its UUID in the free list.
H obtains this lock before validating its after-lock witness.
D Popen child starts and attempts nonblocking lifetime GPU ownership; it raises BlockingIOError and exits nonzero while H holds the lock.
H finds no live old-EfficientNet witness, refuses admission and releases its lock.
D sees the nonzero child exit and marks its queue FAILED.
critical_findings.why_precheck_is_insufficient: An earlier old-child/proc/status precheck may become false between that read and H acquisition under arbitrary scheduling. Only checks after acquisition close the successful branch; they cannot undo a D child failure incurred during a rejected attempt.

admitted_branch_conditional_lemma.argument: If H already holds the canonical GPU flock and an exactly identified child of the original pending-empty D batch still holds both of its lifetime run/GPU locks after that instant, that batch has not returned. Its pending list only decreases and is empty, so it cannot perform another free-check/Popen in that batch. Any later D free check sees the existing H lock.
necessary_conditions: The witness really belongs to the unique P2_STANDARD batch and exact supervisor lifetime; PID starttime, PPid, command/run identity, queue owner and lock device/inode must all match.
At least one original EfficientNet child holds both actual run/GPU kernel locks after the H acquisition; a mere live PID, cached snapshot or previous status is insufficient.
Queue status pending=[] is bound to that same batch; no extra launcher/direct workers are admitted.
D source loaded by the running owner is unchanged; disk-source SHA alone does not prove which code an existing Python process loaded.
Canonical lock files cannot be unlinked/replaced, redirected or separately namespaced.
H retains the same open-file-description lifetime lock through all CUDA work and never reacquires it through a separate FD in nested owned_gpu.
Qualification duplicate/recovery identity locks remain effective, and fresh UUID/occupancy/max4/protected-GPU checks remain mandatory.
admitted_branch_conditional_lemma.limitation: These conditions establish safety only once a valid witness is obtained. They do not make a lock acquisition followed by failed witness harmless.

existing_D_handshake_inventory.queue_lock: queue_d.py:222-229 holds queue.lock exclusively for the complete queue.run lifetime; acquiring it cannot provide an interim concurrent admission window while this D owner is running.
existing_D_handshake_inventory.GPU_locks: queue_d.py:79-82 probes and releases; the future worker independently acquires LOCK_NB in trainer.py:167/177. The lock is shared, but reservation-to-child-start is not a single held lease.

existing_D_handshake_inventory.immutable_D_consequence: Under the prohibition on stopping/hot-changing D and without an already shared cooperative pre-acquisition handshake, this H-only after-lock proposal cannot prove strict no-D-regression concurrent admission.

minimum_next_steps: Keep production H GPU admission closed for this proposal.

A future D-compatible admission design needs atomic reservation retained through worker handoff, or cooperative retry/wait on transient GPU ownership conflict, validated with concurrency/crash/restart/duplicate tests. Those require a separately reviewed future dispatcher/worker change and cannot be retrofitted by an H-only postcheck into this running D owner.
The existing terminal D-cache guard remains the available safe production path while the current owner is immutable. No ETA/fixed sleep or observed idle card is a proof.
